_comment: Data-only lease export profiles read by app/modules/leasing/export_profiles.py. Each profile is a CSV whose columns map a header to a field of the enriched lease row (lease fields plus tenant_name, tenant_kind, tenant_id_scheme, tenant_id_number, tenant_phone, start_date_hijri, end_date_hijri, annual_rent, payments_count, payments_per_year, vat_rate_percent). A profile prepares a file for upload; it is not an integration with the registry and claims no certification. Confirm the column set against the registry's current template per instance.
